caveats: V1 4-digit symbol filter is a proxy, not a verified common-stock security master.
No corporate-action-adjusted prices; do not infer split/dividend adjusted signals.
Historical score acceleration uses same-day price features; no chip/branch scoring.
Market-wide coverage cannot be certified without verified official universe.
Github scheduled jobs may run late; no direct ChatGPT task ingestion guarantee.
History_coverage_pct only counts 80 stored bars and is not an official universe coverage or data accuracy measurement.
Data quality evidence and unresolved missing sessions are in docs/data_quality.json.
OHLCV momentum observations are not verified branch accumulation or out-of-sample forecast accuracy.
Historical event statistics use next-session open, exclude censored horizons, and omit costs/corporate actions.
